raw_findings.body: The entire choice expression, including its runtime-rendered branch text, is deleted before the OWASP sanitizer sees it, so the verifier accepts HTML that can later be emitted into an HTML message or page.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Unsafe HTML embedded in choice branches bypasses build-time verification.
raw_findings.impact: The entire choice expression, including its runtime-rendered branch text, is deleted before the OWASP sanitizer sees it, so the verifier accepts HTML that can later be emitted into an HTML message or page.
raw_findings.root_cause: The workaround for ChoiceFormat comparison operators discards untrusted branch content from the value being checked.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Parse choice expressions and sanitize each branch's text, or mask only the `<` comparison operators in choice boundaries instead of replacing the complete expression.
raw_findings.title: Choice normalization removes branch contents before sanitization
raw_findings.trigger: A `linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit.*` or `error-invalid-multivalued-size` translation places an HTML tag or payload inside a MessageFormat choice branch, for example a tag following `0#`.

raw_findings.body: The loop checks only tags present in the translation, so it reports nothing when source anchors are missing; malformed or non-clickable translated links therefore pass verification.
raw_findings.failure_mode: The verifier produces a false negative for missing or unbalanced translated anchors.
raw_findings.impact: The loop checks only tags present in the translation, so it reports nothing when source anchors are missing; malformed or non-clickable translated links therefore pass verification.
raw_findings.root_cause: Anchor comparison iterates only over target matches and never checks whether the English matcher has unmatched tags remaining.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Extract the ordered anchor-tag sequences from both values, require the complete sequences to match, and only then remove the matched target anchors before general sanitization.
raw_findings.title: Anchor verification accepts translations that omit source anchors
raw_findings.trigger: A translation removes all source anchor tags, or omits a closing anchor while retaining an otherwise identical opening tag.

raw_findings.body: Verification throws a runtime exception and aborts the Maven build, whereas the verifier previously supported checking such bundles for duplicate keys without requiring an English counterpart.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Existing locale-only or differently structured theme projects become incompatible with the verifier.
raw_findings.impact: Verification throws a runtime exception and aborts the Maven build, whereas the verifier previously supported checking such bundles for duplicate keys without requiring an English counterpart.
raw_findings.root_cause: HTML verification assumes every translated resource has an English counterpart at a path inferred from its filename and directory name.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Handle a missing English bundle explicitly: either use the no-HTML policy, emit a normal validation finding, or make the source bundle path configurable rather than unconditionally opening it.
raw_findings.title: Locale-only resource bundles now abort verification
raw_findings.trigger: The plugin verifies a valid resource directory containing `messages_de.properties` or another locale file without a sibling file at the hard-coded derived `messages_en.properties` path.

finding.verifier_reason: The claim assumes locale-only bundles without English counterparts were previously supported. validated_findings.body: i18next no longer recognizes the former `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, and `{{2}}` placeholders, and it does not evaluate Java `choice` syntax, so users see literal formatting expressions instead of the attribute limits.
validated_findings.evidence: error-invalid-multivalued-size=Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Validation errors render untranslated placeholders and a literal choice expression in the account UI.
validated_findings.impact: i18next no longer recognizes the former `{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, and `{{2}}` placeholders, and it does not evaluate Java `choice` syntax, so users see literal formatting expressions instead of the attribute limits.
validated_findings.root_cause: A client-side i18next message was converted to server-side Java MessageFormat syntax.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Keep i18next interpolation syntax in this JS resource and implement singular/plural wording using the frontend's supported pluralization mechanism rather than Java MessageFormat.
validated_findings.title: Java MessageFormat syntax breaks account-ui interpolation
validated_findings.trigger: The account UI translates `error-invalid-multivalued-size` with numeric interpolation arguments through its i18next resource bundle.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch line 188 shows account-ui message changed from i18next `{{0}}` syntax to Java MessageFormat `{0}` syntax. Account-ui uses i18next which won't interpolate Java MessageFormat placeholders, causing literal display.

validated_findings.body: The entire choice expression, including its runtime-rendered branch text, is deleted before the OWASP sanitizer sees it, so the verifier accepts HTML that can later be emitted into an HTML message or page.
validated_findings.failure_mode: Unsafe HTML embedded in choice branches bypasses build-time verification.
validated_findings.impact: The entire choice expression, including its runtime-rendered branch text, is deleted before the OWASP sanitizer sees it, so the verifier accepts HTML that can later be emitted into an HTML message or page.
validated_findings.root_cause: The workaround for ChoiceFormat comparison operators discards untrusted branch content from the value being checked.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Parse choice expressions and sanitize each branch's text, or mask only the `<` comparison operators in choice boundaries instead of replacing the complete expression.
validated_findings.title: Choice normalization removes branch contents before sanitization
validated_findings.trigger: A `linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit.*` or `error-invalid-multivalued-size` translation places an HTML tag or payload inside a MessageFormat choice branch, for example a tag following `0#`.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: The normalizeValue method replaces choice expressions before sanitization to handle the `<` comparison operator issue, but the claim that this bypasses security is speculative. The sanitizer still runs on the remaining content, and the choice branches in these specific keys are controlled by developers, not user input.

validated_findings.body: The loop checks only tags present in the translation, so it reports nothing when source anchors are missing; malformed or non-clickable translated links therefore pass verification.
validated_findings.failure_mode: The verifier produces a false negative for missing or unbalanced translated anchors.
validated_findings.impact: The loop checks only tags present in the translation, so it reports nothing when source anchors are missing; malformed or non-clickable translated links therefore pass verification.
validated_findings.root_cause: Anchor comparison iterates only over target matches and never checks whether the English matcher has unmatched tags remaining.
validated_findings.suggested_fix: Extract the ordered anchor-tag sequences from both values, require the complete sequences to match, and only then remove the matched target anchors before general sanitization.
validated_findings.title: Anchor verification accepts translations that omit source anchors
validated_findings.trigger: A translation removes all source anchor tags, or omits a closing anchor while retaining an otherwise identical opening tag.
validated_findings.verifier_reason: Patch line 153 shows the loop only iterates over target matcher finds. If translation omits anchors present in English, englishMatcher.find() is never called for those, so missing anchors pass silently. This is a real false-negative bug in verification logic.
